CustomField.description: Name of the lending institution, as free text. NAMED Lender_Name__c AND NOT Lender__c ON PURPOSE: this repo naming convention reserves an object-shaped field name for a lookup to that object, and no Lender__c object exists, so a Text field called Lender__c would be camouflaged as a relationship by the convention itself. Direct precedent: Vendor_Contract__c.Provider_Name__c. If the business later wants the lender to be an Account, that is an additive change plus a backfill, not a rename.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Name of the bank or lender providing the loan.
CustomField.label: Lender Name
